d: THE CLOCKWORK MENAGERIE #2 — Onthuneia's Invention. Onthuneia hurries toward Cogsworth Lane, automaton waking flaring. Starring Onthuneia (Kafell Lufaro), Dremaraus (Luglen Lutal), Tredoraia (Fatal Loren). Tinkerers and their brass automatons keep the gear-city wound — and someone keeps loosening the springs.
